name: Traitors.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Traitors.io is a free survival style iogame. The art in this game is minimal and aesthetic. Itis a game where survival is paramount and tactics are key. pay attention to the instructions because this is a complex game with aa lot of fun and interesting choices as well as a whole world of different strategies which can be employed. This is a fun game which is also a multi-player because it is an iogame. This means that you'll be going up against real-life players as you navigate a large, open-world arena with dozens of different choices to make and strategies you can employ.
